'''214736184505796''' was the designation of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a member of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Scrapbook" /> a conflict that spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Made from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Scrapbook" /> 214736184505796 was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Scrapbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
214736184505796 was mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]'' by [[Ryder Windham]], where they were labeled as CLONE TROOPER NO. 214736184505796.<ref name="Scrapbook" />
